messages.text: Canaria is a lightweight, real-time earthquake early warning system.
It aggregates earthquake data from multiple sources: KMA (Korea), JMA (Japan), WolfX EEW, and P2PQuake.
This multi-source approach ensures comprehensive coverage across Asia-Pacific.
Two main components: A Parser (Bun/TypeScript) that normalizes event data, and a Worker (Cloudflare Workers) that ingests data and manages state.
It uses Durable Objects for state consistency and SQLite for event storage.
Real-time WebSocket streaming, persistent history via SQLite, and automatic feed monitoring with backoff strategies.
It's globally distributed on Cloudflare's edge network for low latency.
Bun, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, and ElysiaJS for the API framework.
